# GeoBusiness Intelligence Studio

Canonical project page: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/geo-business-intelligence-studio/
Source repository: https://github.com/FaramarzKowsari/geo-business-intelligence-studio
Guidebook: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/geo-business-intelligence-studio/guidebook/
Guidebook PDF: https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/geo-business-intelligence-studio/guidebook/inside-geobusiness-intelligence-studio.pdf

GeoBusiness Intelligence Studio is a privacy-aware FastAPI platform by Faramarz Kowsari for discovering, normalizing, deduplicating, mapping, analyzing, and exporting local-business records.

Core providers:
- fictional offline sample records;
- OpenStreetMap through Nominatim and Overpass;
- optional official Google Places Text Search with the user's own API key.

Core capabilities:
- common provider adapter interface;
- Pydantic validation and OpenAPI documentation;
- data normalization and visible provenance;
- probable duplicate removal;
- interpretable data-completeness scoring;
- Leaflet mapping;
- CSV and JSON export;
- deterministic analysis without AI;
- optional Ollama or OpenAI-compatible BYOK analysis;
- Docker, tests, and GitHub Actions CI.

The repository does not scrape the Google Maps website, bypass CAPTCHAs, rotate identities, or evade access controls.

Author:
Faramarz Kowsari — author, Software Engineer, and AI researcher.
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1692-0453
